elements.text:
1. A hobby that needs great patience
2. Building a tiny world by hand
3. A quiet game of strategy
4. Earning money from a hobby
5. Making music to relax
6. A healthy activity in the water
7. Gathering objects from around the world

1. A hobby that needs great patience
2. Building a tiny world by hand
3. A quiet game of strategy
4. Earning money from a hobby
5. Making music to relax
6. A healthy activity in the water
7. Gathering objects from around the world

elements.text:
A. Chess is my favourite way to spend a rainy afternoon. I play against my
grandfather every Sunday, and he almost always wins. The game teaches me to
think ahead and stay calm. I don't need any expensive equipment, just a board
and thirty-two small pieces on the table.

B. I started collecting old coins two years ago. My uncle gave me his first
box, and now I have more than two hundred coins from many countries. Some
of
them are over a hundred years old. I keep them in a special album and study
their history at weekends whenever I have free time.

C. Every summer our whole family goes swimming at the local lake. The water
is
cool and clean, and my little sister is learning too. Swimming keeps me strong
and healthy, and after an hour in the water I always feel wonderfully relaxed
and ready to eat a big lunch.

D. I love taking photos of birds in the park near my house. It requires a lot
of patience because birds fly away quickly. I sit quietly for hours with my
camera, waiting for the perfect moment. Last month I finally took a beautiful
picture of a bright blue kingfisher.

E. My brother and I built a small model railway in our garage. We spent many
months painting tiny houses and trees for it. The little trains run through
miniature mountains and villages. Visitors are always surprised by how much
detail we have added to our little world of trains.

F. Playing the guitar helps me forget about my problems after a hard day at
school. I practise new songs every evening in my room. My fingers hurt at
first, but now they are stronger. One day I hope to perform in front of a real
audience at a big concert.
